publication_bundle_hash_scope: Exact released-byte SHA-256, calculated by analysis/run_checks.py from public release content in explicit relative POSIX-path order. RELEASE_METADATA.json, dynamic validation/build reports, bytecode, caches, and the generated hash manifest are excluded. This is an integrity identifier, not a promise that noncanonical cross-platform Pillow PNG rendering is byte-identical.
publication_bundle_hash_change_reason: The v1.1 release content changed during final scientific, citation, provenance, terminology, evidence, canonical-build, license, and documentation corrections. Exact released-byte integrity is now explicitly separate from calculation-level reproduction: generated text uses UTF-8/LF, nonportable Pillow figure renders are staged unless explicitly replaced, and historical sanitized result artifacts retain their checksum-bound bytes. Excluded metadata and validation reports avoid self-reference and timestamp instability; historical benchmark data and historical raw hashes are unchanged.
current_source_bundle_hash_scope: analysis/, benchmark/, and paper/references.bib under the same explicit relative POSIX-path ordering algorithm.
